comment: Teacher accurately supports story recall, inference, cliffhanger, close reading, nonfiction features, annotation, vocabulary, and text-dependent questions.
Lesson builds from story facts to motivation/inference, then shifts to parallel informational text, annotation, vocabulary, hemispheres, and group roles.
Teacher elicits many student responses and checks understanding, although several recall questions require repeated prompting before the target idea is surfaced.
Teacher uses why/how/deeper prompts around character motivation, author ending, nonfiction identification, vocabulary, and text-dependent evidence.
Good text-evidence lesson, with minor opportunities to give more think time and formalise central idea/theme distinction before group work.
